verdict.rationale: Bruno ships a built-in AI assistant (Bruno AI) accessible via an AI icon in Scripts/Tests/Docs tabs and a workspace-wide AI Chat Sidebar, letting users delegate script generation, test writing, documentation, and even full app generation to the assistant, with review-before-accept safeguards. missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of the AI assistant's real-world quality/reliability (evidence is entirely first-party docs), and clarity on how well it performs versus documented limitations.
